generated_at_note: all numbers recomputed from the artefacts on disk

provenance.traceability: per-entity evidence code + reference (PMID/ORPHA) + HPO release + phenotype.hpoa version, recorded inside every case

checks_that_are_independent: span integrity (entity text vs recorded offsets)
hp_id existence in the HPO snapshot
affirmed/suspected/history membership in the disease annotation set (verifies the emitter honours its own sampling contract, NOT medical truth)
unit conversion arithmetic, re-derived in the validator
near-duplicate statistics over the generated text
checks_that_are_tautological_by_construc: knowledge consistency: the generator samples phenotypes FROM the annotation set, so a violation would indicate an implementation bug, not a medical claim
lab direction: direction and interval come from the same table the sampler used; an error in the table would pass both sides
reference intervals themselves are demonstration values, not institutional standards
circularity.known_shared_failure_mode: the g/dL->g/L direction bug was invisible until the two code paths diverged; constant-level circularity remains

answer_leakage.note: the disease label is also stated in the note text; a record whose template skeleton and disease coincide with a training record lets the model copy the answer. The triple-collision rate above is the relevant quantity.

split_leakage.verdict: NOT a generalisation benchmark: splits share templates and diseases. They are usable as a formatting / schema-compliance training set, not as evidence of transfer.

translation.review_status: single-author machine-assisted translation, spot-checked; NO clinician or professional translator review
translation.residual_risk: HPO publishes no official Chinese release; synonym coverage in Chinese is limited to 214 curated surfaces, so recall on unseen Chinese phrasings is not measurable here.

preference_labels.hallucinate_check_note: the appended (last) hp_id is compared against the record-level gold annotation set; the constant HP:0001945 check used before sft-export-2.0.0 was retired because the rule no longer always samples Fever, which made 22/2,332 rejected answers defensible
preference_labels.label_status: programmatic corruption, NOT human preference annotation
preference_labels.usable_for: DPO/RLHF plumbing tests and format-supervision experiments only
preference_labels.not_usable_for: any claim about human preference quality or reward-model accuracy

context_contamination.gate: SFT/preference export must not be used for training while this number is non-zero for context status; the corrected pipeline run is pipeline-med-1.1.0.
